verdict.rationale: HeyGen's API is broad. It covers video generation with full control over avatar, voice and style, Video Agent storyboard review and scene revision, photo avatars, cinematic avatar videos, real-time LiveAvatar, account and credit info, and scoped keys. It also offers batch calls with webhooks and REST/CLI/MCP access. However, no evidence asserts or shows full UI parity: several UI and plan features appear only on pricing and marketing pages with no API equivalent shown. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim, API coverage of the brand kit and asset library, translation script editing, SCORM/LMS export, 4K export and workspace/role management, a discoverable OpenAPI spec (probed paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
